instructions: Zenit Week is a weekly planner shown as a mind map: branches (categories) hold tasks, tasks may hold sub-tasks. All writes act on the week open in the app, exactly as if the user clicked; each call is one undo step and shows the user a toast. Read zenit://week/current (or call get_stats) first to learn branch and task ids. Use open_week to switch weeks before writing to another week. Before proposing what a week should carry, read zenit://vision: the user's long view, a mind map of intentions (branches are life areas, comments say why). The Vision has no days, ticks or done; an intention can be let go (set_status dropped) and taken back (undone), and has an optional horizon (set_horizon). The node tools act on the record in view: call open_vision before writing to an intention and open_week to come back. An id from the other record answers not_in_view. To learn what the user finished (the last task done, what got done today), read the done group of zenit://agenda/{day}: one row per task or tick the user closed, oldest first, each with its doneAt. Do not sort the week by doneAt: a parent closed by its children rolling up carries a doneAt of its own but was not closed by the user. When the user asks to see something ("show me"), call show_task with its id: it brings the browser forward, opens the right week or the Vision and pulses the item. Days are ISO weekdays: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday. A label ending in "Nx" (e.g. "Pushups 10x") makes N ticks recorded with tick_task; days and Nx do not combine. Never put relative days (today, tomorrow) in labels: pass days instead. The first request may answer that Zenit Week is not connected yet and give a code: tell the user that code, ask them to check it matches the one shown in Zenit Week and click Allow there, and call again only after they confirm. Every result names the app that ran it in "app": "Zenit Week" for the production site, a host name such as abc.ngrok-free.app for a development copy. When zenit://apps lists more than one app, pass "app" on every call (on a resource: ?app=<name>) and say which app you changed. A result may carry "update" or "notice": pass it on to the user in your reply.

tools.name: open_week
tools.description: Show a week in the app (navigation, not an undo step); also leaves the Vision. Required before writing to a week other than the one in view. Creates the week if absent. Returns the week.

tools.name: open_vision
tools.description: Show the Vision (the long-view mind map) in the app: navigation, not an undo step. Required before writing to an intention. Returns the vision.

tools.name: show_task
tools.description: Show the user a task, intention or branch, when they say "show me": brings the browser to the front, opens the record that holds it (the week in view, the Vision, the week given, else the newest stored week with it), zooms the map in and pulses it. Navigation, not an undo step. "raised": false means the browser could not be brought forward; ask the user to switch to it.

id.description: Node id: a task, intention or branch

week.description: ISO week key YYYY-WW, when the id is in a week not in view

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Add a task to the week in view, or an intention to the Vision when it is in view (no days, no Nx there). A label like "Pushups 10x" makes 10 ticks on a week. Pass days for weekdays; never "today"/"tomorrow" in a week label. Returns the new task.

branch.description: Branch id or its exact name

parent.description: Task id to add a sub-task under

tools.name: rename_task
tools.description: Rename a task. Day tokens in the label, e.g. "Run (mo, we)", replace its days; "Nx" sets ticks.

id.description: Node id from a week read

tools.name: set_status
tools.description: Mark a task done, undone (reopens done or dropped), dropped (will not happen), unplanned or planned. Cascades to sub-tasks. On the Vision only dropped (let go) and undone (take back).

id.description: Node id from a week read

tools.name: set_priority
tools.description: Set a task priority (cascades to sub-tasks). Same value is a no-op.

id.description: Node id from a week read

tools.name: set_horizon
tools.description: Set when an intention is meant to happen: this year, in a few years, someday, or none. Vision only. Same value is a no-op.

id.description: Node id from a week read

tools.name: set_days
tools.description: Replace the weekdays of a task. Empty array removes all days. Days remove Nx ticks.

id.description: Node id from a week read

tools.name: tick_task
tools.description: Record n repetitions of an Nx task (negative n reopens the last ones).

id.description: Node id from a week read

tools.name: set_comment
tools.description: Replace the comment of a task with Markdown (max 20000 chars; links http, https or mailto only).

id.description: Node id from a week read

tools.name: set_reusable
tools.description: Mark a task reusable (copied by transfer_reusable to the next week) or not.

id.description: Node id from a week read

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Delete a task at once. A date of a repeating schedule entry needs scope "occurrence" or "series".

id.description: Node id from a week read

tools.name: send_to_date
tools.description: Move a task out of this week to a date (YYYY-MM-DD), optionally repeating. A one-off date inside the same week just sets its weekday.

id.description: Node id from a week read

tools.name: transfer_unfinished
tools.description: Copy the previous week's unfinished tasks into the week in view, as the context menu does.

tools.name: transfer_reusable
tools.description: Copy the previous week's reusable tasks into the week in view.

tools.name: add_branch
tools.description: Add a branch (category) to the record in view: a week, or the Vision.

tools.name: rename_branch
tools.description: Rename a branch (category) of the record in view: a week, or the Vision. The label is literal.

branch.description: Branch id or its exact name

tools.name: delete_branch
tools.description: Delete a branch of the record in view with everything under it. The last branch cannot be deleted.

branch.description: Branch id or its exact name

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last action in the app, whoever made it. Says which action it undid.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone action.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Completion statistics of the week in view.

resources.name: weeks
resources.description: Weeks stored on this device with task counts.

resources.name: week-current
resources.description: The week in view: branches, tasks, days, ticks, status, ids.

resources.name: schedule
resources.description: Dated and repeating entries (the Later tab).

resources.name: vision
resources.description: The Vision: life areas (branches) and intentions with priority, horizon, let-go state and comments (the why). Read it before proposing a week.

resources.name: agenda
resources.description: Agenda of the week in view for ISO day 1-7. Its done group is the day's log of what the user finished, oldest first.

resources.name: apps
resources.description: The Zenit Week apps (production, dev copies) with a tab connected now: app name, paired, week in view, visible, focused. Pass one of the names as "app".
